msContents.summary: A palm-leaf manuscript of the Itihāsasamuccaya.

lg.l: kathayaṃtaṃ hi tīrtthānām_ prabhāvān at_bhutāṃm api
romaśan dharmmatatvajñam_ paryyapṛchśad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ |
yo rakṣet_ prāṇināṃ rājā bhayārttaṃ śaraṇāgatam |

tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat_ syāt tan me brūhi ta
podhana |
ekataḥ kratavas sarvve samagrā varadakṣiṇāḥ |
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ |

tulayā tolayat_ brahmā tayor abhayado
dhikaḥ |
atraivodāharantimam itihāsam_ purātanam |
indraśyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śiber auśīnarasya ca |

varttamāne mahāyajñe
jijñāsārtthaṃ śibin nṛpam |
iṃdraś śyenaḥ kapoto gnir bhūtvā tatropajagmatuḥ |
athāṃkan nṛpateḥ prāpya kapoto
ṇārtthī mahīpālan nililye bhayavihvalaḥ |
tataś śanair upāgamya śyenarūpi sureśvaraḥ |
rājānaṃ sumahātmānam_ provācedaṃ vacas tadā |

dharmmā
tmānan tvām ihaivāhur ekaṃ rājan mahīkṣitām |
sa tvan dharmmaviruddhaṃ hi kathan dharmmañ cikīrṣasi |
bhavān_ kṛtaghnān dānena satyenānṛtavādinam |

kṣamayā
kūrakarmmāṇam asādhuṃ sādhunā jayat |
nopakāraphalo py evam upakāraparo janaḥ |
apakārapare pi tvam upakāraparo yathā |
ahite tvaṃ hitaḥ pāpe tvam apapo hi sarvvadā |
doṣānveṣaṇadakṣo pi guṇānveṣaṇatat_paraḥ |

sadaiva vihito bhakṣaḥ pīḍyamātasya me
kṣudhā |
mā hiṃsīr llobhato dharmman dharmmam ut_sṛṣṭavān asi |
santrastarūpas trāṇārtthī tvatto bhīto vihaṃgamaḥ |

mat_sakāśam anuprāptaḥ prā
ṇagrudhnurayaṃ khagaḥ |
tad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasyābhayārtthinaḥ |
katham asmadvidhaḥ kuryyāt tyāgaṃ sat_bhir vvigarhitam |

lobhād veṣāt_ bhayād vāpi ya
ch śaraṇaṃ gatam |
brahmahatyāsaman tasya pāpam āhur mmanīṣiṇaḥ |
śāstreṣu niṣkṛtir ddṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām api |
śaraṇāgatahantus tu na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ kva
yathātmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇās sarvveṣām_ prāṇinān tathā |
tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastās trātavyāḥ prāṇino budhaiḥ |
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhair nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare |
jantavaḥ parikliśyante mṛtyoḥs trasyanti te tataḥ |
yannimittam_ bhavech śokas trāso vā krodha eva vā |
āyāso vā yato mūlaṃ ekaṃgam api tan tyajet |

mariṣyāmī
ti yad duḥkham_ puruṣasyopajāyate |
jñeyas tenānumānena paro pi parirakṣitum |

yathā ca te jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyan tathā pareṣām api
jīvitam_ priyam |
saṃrakṣase jīvitam ātmano yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitam |
tasmān nāham imam_ bhītam arppayiṣye kapotakam |

yad atra yukta manya
tte vaktuṃ śyenāśu tad vada |
āhārāt_ sarvvabhūtāni sam_bhavanti nareśvara |
āhāreṇaiva varddhante tena jīvanti jantavaḥ |

śakyate duṣkare py artthe
cirarātreṇa jīvitum |
na tv āhāravihīne na śakyaṃ varttayituṃ kvacit |
bhakṣyād vilopitasyāsya mama prāṇā viṣāṃ pate |

vi
panthānam akutobhayam |
mṛte ca mayi sarvvam me putradāram mariṣyati |
rakṣyamāṇaḥ kapotan tvam_ bahūn_ prāṇān si |

dha bādhate dha
na sa dharmmaḥ parantapa |
avirodhī tu yo dharmmas sa dharmmas sat_bhir ucyate |
tasmād virodhe dharmmasya vicintya gurulāghavam |

yato bhūyas tato rājan_ kuru dharmma
vinirṇṇayam |
nāto bhayāt_ strato dharmmaḥ kaścid anyo sti khecara |
prāṇitām_ bhayabhītānāmm abhayaṃ yat_ pradīyate |

varam ekasya satvasya pradattajī
vitābhayam |
abhayaṃ sarvvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ |
tasya dehād vimuktasya kṣaya eva na vidyate |
dattam iṣṭan tapas taptan tīrtthaṃ vedā śrutan tathā |

sarvvā
ṇy abhayadānasya kalān nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm
catussāgaraparyyantāṃ yo dadyāt_ pṛthivīm imām |
abhayaṃ sarvvabhūtebhyas tayor abhayado dhikaḥ |

api tyaje rājya
m idaṃ śarīraṃ vā sa dustyajam |
na kṣamam_ bhayasantrantrastan tyakṣye dīnaṃ kapotakam |
yan mamāsti śubhaṃ kiñcit tena janmani janmani |

bhave trātā bhayārttānām ārtti
nāśāya dehinām |
na hy ahaṃ kāmaye rājyan na svargan nāpunarbhavam |
prāṇinān duḥkhataptānāṃ kāmaye duḥkhanāśanam |

yathā ca nānṛtā
m aham etām udāhare |
satyenānena bhagavān_ prasīdatu janārddana ||
āhārārtthe samāhārambhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgama |
tad yatheṣṭan tavāhāram anyam eva dadāmy aham |
yady eva vihito smākan dātrā bhakṣaḥ kapotakaḥ |
tam evot_sṛjya nāhāraiḥ kāryyam asty aparair mmama |

śyenāḥ kapotān_ khādanti śrutir e
ṣā sanātanī |
mā rājan_ sāratāṃ jñātvā kadaḷīstambham āruha |
nāhaṅ kuśāstramārgeṇa kvacid vartte vihaṃgama |

śāstrair evopadiṣṭo yan dharmma
s satvadayāparaḥ |
sarvvasatveṣu yad dānaṃ ekasatve ca yā dayā |
sarvvasatvapradānāt tu dayaikasmin viśiṣyate |

sarvvavedā na tat_ kuryyus sarvve yajñāś ca
khecara |
sarvvatīrtthābhiṣekaś ca yat_ kuryyāt_ prāṇinān dayā |
vāṅ_manaḥkarmmabhir yye tu sarvvabhūtahite ratāḥ |

dayādarśitapajthāno brahmalokaṃ
vrajanti te |
gachśatas tiṣṭhato vāpi jāgratasvpato pi vā |
yan na bhūtahitārtthāya tat_ paśor iva ceṣṭitam |
jaṃgamāni ca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ |
ātmavat_ parirakṣanti na te yānti parābhavam |
prāṇinam_ bāddhyamānan tu yaś śaktas samupekṣate |
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram iti prāṣiṇaḥ |
śibīnāṃ sakalam_ prayachśāmi tava dvija |
yad vā kāmayase hy anyad varjjayitvā kapotakam |
yadi rājan_ kapote te sudṛḍhā bhakti
tulyāni svamāṃsāni prayachśa me |
anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ śyenābhiyācase |
etat te ham_ prayachśāmi manmāṃsaṃ yāvad ichśasi |

yad apriyam
rād vadati vā na vā |
mama tu priyam evaitat_ kasmād abhihitan cirāt |
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā |

dhruvaṃ yo nārjjayed dharmmaṃ sa
ḍhacetanaḥ |
yadi prāṇyupakārāya deho yan nopayujyate |
tataḥ kim upacāro sya pratyahaṃ kriyate vṛthā |

nātiriktam imaṃ yāce ta
va māṃsañ janeśvara |
tasmāt_ kapotena samam_ prayachśa tulayā dhṛtam |
tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yan māṃ śyenābhiyācase |

yenāsya rakṣaṇam me
syāt tadvat tāvad vihaṃgama |
evam uktvā svamāṃsāni samut_kṛttāni pārtthivaḥ |
prahṛṣṭas tolayāmāsa kapotena saha prabhuḥ |

tyaktvātmasu
khabhogechśāṃ sarvvasatvasukhaiṣiṇaḥ |
bhabhavanti paraduḥkhaenani sādhavo nityaduḥkhatāḥ |
dhriyamāṇas tu tulayā kapoto vyatricyate |

puna
ś cot_kṛtya māṃsani tataḥ prādāt_ sa pārtthivaḥ |
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit |

prakṣīṇamāṃso sāv ārūroha tulāṃ
svayam |
paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ sarvvabhūtahite ratāḥ |
nāvekṣante mahātmāna svaduḥkhāni mahānty api |

atha tasmin_ samārūḍhe tulām auśī
nareśvare |
devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ha |
tatas tasya tadā matvā dharmme rājño dhṛtim_ parām |

śākrasvarūpam āsthāya
vākyam etad abhāṣata |
indro ham asmi bhadran te kapoto havyavāḍayam |
jijñāsamānau tvāṃ rājan_ imaṃ yajñam upagatau |
naitat_ pūrvve nṛpāś cakrur na kariṣyanti cāpare |
mahākāruṇikeneha yat_ kṛtan duṣkaran tvayā |

parārtthe tyajato prāṇān_
tir abhavat tava |
prāṇasaṃśayalubdheṣu na sā prāneṣu dehinām |
parārtthaikāntakalyāṇī svāśrayātyantaniṣṭhurā |

tvayy eva ke
karuṇākaruṇāyate |
svakarmmapāśais sudṛḍhair baddhaṃ kṛtsnam idañ jagat |
tvañ jagadduḥkhamokṣārttham_ baddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpa |
tathā sarvvātmanā cāpi doṣeṣu prahṛtan tvayā |
yathā caivātmana sthāne vāsanāpi na ceṣṭitā |
akṛtverṣyāṃ viśiṣṭeṣu hīnān anavamanya ca |
agatas sadṛśai sparddhan tvaṃ lokottamatāṃ gataḥ |
ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇān yo naraḥ parirakṣati |

sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yasmān nā varttate pu
naḥ |
prāṇair api tvayā rājan rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇo janaḥ |
svamāṃsāny api dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā |

paśavo pi hi jīvanti kevalātmo
darambharāḥ |
sa punar jīvati ślāghyo yaḥ parārtthaṃ hi jīvati |
kim atra citraṃ yat_ santaḥ parānugrahatat_parāḥ |

na hi svadehaśaityāya
jāyate candanadrumaḥ |
paropakāravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣas sadā |
sapadan tad avāpnoti parād api hi yat_ param |

paropa
kāraikadhiya svasukhāya gataspṛhāḥ |
jagaddhitāya jāyante sādhavas tv ādṛśā janāḥ |

yat te māṃsāni gātrebhyas samut_kṛttāni pārtthi
va |
eṣā te śāśvatī kīrttir llokān anugamiṣyati |
divyarūpadharaś caiva pālayitvā ca medinīm |

sarvvān_ lokān atikramya
lokaṃ gamiṣyasi |
evam uktvā tam indrāgnī jagmatus tridaśālayam |
rājā tu kratum iṣṭvāsau mumude devavat tadā |

ya idaṃ śṛ
yān nityaṃ śibeś caritam at_bhutam uttamam |
sa vidhūyeha pāpāni prayāti tridivan naraḥ |

vicintya rājā svaśarīram adhruvan dhruvaṃ yaśas sarvvajana
sya durllabham |
śarīradānāt_ parajīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau |

body.p:
iti śrī tihāsasamut_ccaye śyenakapotīyan nāma catu
rttho dhyayaḥ
